foundation.framingA.title: Uyu ni muhingano wetu wa mbele.
foundation.framingA.body:
Mibuzo sita ntwale — mbali unga kufwa hanyuma ya mitatu na kuwona kuweswa kwako kwa mbele.

Kavuna majibu ya haki. Ya ukweli inashinda ya kuangaza.

Uku sio kujaribu. Ni picha ya mbele ya hapo uko sasa, kenda nifike pale.
foundation.framingA.skip: Sikiza kwa sasa — tumia ya kawaida
foundation.framingB.title: Ndi tuu twawe.
foundation.framingB.body:
Kyaa kĩu watũmaa nĩkyo kĩkuumbwa ta kĩwailo kyawe.

Matuku ma kũũka nĩnĩkwongela kũvanga — ũũ ti ũkoti, nĩ mweke wa mbere.
foundation.qcard.skipAhead: Dumela pele — bontsha sefe sa me jaanong
foundation.q1.title: Ke mantswe afe a a letang thata mo go wena jaanong?
foundation.q1.subtitle: Go ya go 4. Nna boammaaruri.
foundation.q1.opt1: Ga go lekana — ga ke dire go le gontsi
foundation.q1.opt2: Taolo — fa nka lesa, tsotlhe di wa
foundation.q1.opt3: Go tila — go tshameka, go bala, go idiba
foundation.q1.opt4: Leuba — poifo e le nngwe, pale e le nngwe, leotwana le le lengwe
foundation.q1.opt5: Go idibala ga batho — nka se kgone go re nnyaa
foundation.q1.opt6: Boitekanelo — 'ke mang tota?' ga e tswe
foundation.q2.title: Ma-o chiki-o tempo-o ka-o t-o tum-o siki-o-to?
foundation.q2.subtitle: N-o aspira-o. Wa-o current-o jii-o wi-o-o give-o.
foundation.q2.opt1: Gentle-o — one-o small-o ritual-o, sustainable-o forever-o
foundation.q3.title: Kwen yu dey-drim abaut yor bes sel, deym bi...
foundation.q3.opt4: Nenjwan — ngom, kele, awum a mvu
foundation.q3.opt5: Afu ndu — kene a mo mbe mvu
foundation.q3.opt6: Ngo ngom mpa a sso mvo
foundation.q3.opt8: A mpa ma mo mbe omuk a mvu
foundation.q3.opt9: Mu mpa nso / mfam / mvu mpa
foundation.q3.opt10: Ke mba ba nso — ndu nwan
foundation.q3.opt11: Nwan mu nso, ke teta mo
foundation.q4.title: Letjha leliphi lelisemkhatsini kuta kwakho nyalo?
foundation.q5.opt3: A mox zùl mèd zòb zîd jûd
foundation.q5.opt4: A mox zùl hûb hân bîs
foundation.q5.opt5: Mî gû lîb zîk mî tîw
foundation.q6.title: Hûng mû zû mèn mèd?
foundation.q6.opt2: Mî tîm zùl zâp zû gû rîp
foundation.q6.opt3: Wîk mû mî zûp kâ zâp
foundation.q7.title: Loktɛndɛ yɔr wii kɔy, nɛ i gaa ndu bɛɛ?
foundation.q7.subtitle: Hɛr i mɔv nɛ dii.
foundation.q7.opt1: Nɛ mɩ gaa — tɛr, plan, rɛplɛy
foundation.q7.opt2: Nɛ mɩ hɛt — fɩl, rɛt fɔ sɔmwɔn
foundation.paths.title: Gwele a gwehezi.
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Ndiyeta le nto ikhoyo, ngaphandle kokubamba okanye ukutyhala. Yonke indlela esihamba kunye nayo iqala kule ntlalo.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: Wannan shi ne wurin farawa — ba keji ba. Hanyarku za ta canza yayin da kuke yi.
